needed.evidence: A continuous green metal fence runs along the entire left side, preventing pedestrian access to the road from the other side.
needed.suggestion: Replace the continuous green metal fence on the left with a standard sidewalk and a lower, permeable fence to allow safe pedestrian access.

needed.evidence: The road has commercial activity and homes on both sides, creating a high demand for crossing, but there are no marked or purpose-built pedestrian crossings.
needed.suggestion: Install a high-visibility zebra crossing at the location of the 'I DAVAO' sign on the right to provide a safe and legal place for pedestrians to cross.

needed.evidence: The absence of any crossing facility on a road with high pedestrian demand is itself a poor condition, forcing pedestrians to cross at unmarked and dangerous 30
needed.suggestion: Prioritize the installation of a marked crossing in this section, as the current lack of one is a significant safety defect.

needed.evidence: There are no street lights visible along this urban road in any of the frames.
needed.suggestion: Install a series of streetlights along both sides of the road to improve visibility for all road users, especially at night.
